name: Eleonora
source: [spoiler]Elle is the other side of An's split personality and a shinigami, two souls in one body. During the day, An goes to school and enjoy her life, while during night time in her sleep, Elle takes over to do their 'shinigami duties'. Elle seems to care a lot for An and would do anything to make her happy.[/spoiler]
